minimum_area_rationale: The floor effort allocation already refuses to spend against. Reusing it means the routing introduces no new scientific threshold; it only decides what happens to the surfaces that were already below one.

routes.STANDARD_QC_PENDING: At or above the floor. Physical QC and the canonical downstream path proceed exactly as before this policy existed.
routes.SMALL_SURFACE_DIAGNOSTIC: Below the floor. The artifact and its geometry certificate are preserved as diagnostic evidence. The surface does not enter the physical-QC queue, P3, or any canonical downstream stage.

explicit_non_claims: SMALL_SURFACE_DIAGNOSTIC is not a finding of no ink.
SMALL_SURFACE_DIAGNOSTIC is not a geometry rejection and does not alter the geometry verdict.
SMALL_SURFACE_DIAGNOSTIC is not a physical-QC verdict and no physical-QC outcome may be written from it.

promotion.requirement: The resumed attempt must produce a new surface that independently measures at or above the floor and passes every standard geometry and physical-QC gate on its own evidence.
